verses.en: The word of the LORD which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.
verses.pt: A palavra do Senhor que veio a Sofonias, filho de Cuche, filho de Gedalias, filho de Amarias, filho de Ezequias, nos dias de Josias, filho de Amom, rei de Judá.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word which came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.
verses.en_bbe: The word of the Lord which came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.

verses.en: I will utterly consume all things from off the land, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Hei de consumir por completo tudo sobre a face da terra, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth, says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: I will take away everything from the face of the earth, says the Lord.

verses.en: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumblingblocks with the wicked; and I will cut off man from off the land, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Consumirei os homens e os animais; consumirei as aves do céu, e os peixes do mar, e os tropeços juntamente com os ímpios; e exterminarei os homens de sobre a face da terra, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: I will sweep away man and animal. I will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble with the wicked. I will cut off man from the surface of the earth, says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: I will take away man and beast; I will take away the birds of the heaven and the fishes of the sea; causing the downfall of the evil-doers, and cutting man off from the face of the earth, says the Lord.

verses.en: I will also stretch out mine hand upon Judah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, and the name of the Chemarims with the priests;
verses.pt: E estenderei a minha mão contra Judá, e contra todos os habitantes de Jerusalém; e exterminarei deste lugar o resto de Baal, e os nomes dos sacerdotes de ídolos, juntamente com os sacerdotes;
verses.en_web: I will stretch out my hand against Judah, and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place: the name of the idolatrous and pagan priests,
verses.en_bbe: And my hand will be stretched out on Judah and on all the people of Jerusalem, cutting off the name of the Baal from this place, and the name of the false priests,

verses.en: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship and that swear by the LORD, and that swear by Malcham;
verses.pt: e os que sobre os telhados adoram o exército do céu, e aqueles adoradores que juram ao Senhor, e juram por Milcom;
verses.en_web: those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops, those who worship and swear by Yahweh and also swear by Malcam,
verses.en_bbe: And the worshippers of the army of heaven on the house-tops, and the Lord's worshippers who take oaths by Milcom,

verses.en: And them that are turned back from the LORD; and those that have not sought the LORD, nor enquired for him.
verses.pt: e os que deixam de seguir ao Senhor, e os que não buscam ao Senhor, nem perguntam por ele.
verses.en_web: those who have turned back from following Yahweh, and those who haven’t sought Yahweh nor inquired after him.
verses.en_bbe: And those who are turned back from going after the Lord, and those who have not made prayer to the Lord or got directions from him.

verses.en: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord GOD: for the day of the LORD is at hand: for the LORD hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath bid his guests.
verses.pt: Cala-te diante do Senhor Deus, porque o dia do Senhor está perto; pois o Senhor tem preparado um sacrifício, e tem santificado os seus convidados.
verses.en_web: Be silent at the presence of the Lord Yahweh, for the day of Yahweh is at hand. For Yahweh has prepared a sacrifice. He has consecrated his guests.
verses.en_bbe: Let there be no sound before the Lord God: for the day of the Lord is near: for the Lord has made ready an offering, he has made his guests holy.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in the day of the LORD’S sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king’s children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.
verses.pt: E no dia do sacrifício do Senhor castigarei os oficiais, e os filhos do rei, e todos os que se vestem de trajes estrangeiros.
verses.en_web: It will happen in the day of Yahweh’s sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, the king’s sons, and all those who are clothed with foreign clothing.
verses.en_bbe: And it will come about in the day of the Lord's offering, that I will send punishment on the rulers and the king's sons and all who are clothed in robes from strange lands.

verses.en: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, which fill their masters’ houses with violence and deceit.
verses.pt: Castigarei também naquele dia todos aqueles que saltam sobre o umbral, que enchem de violência e de dolo a casa do seu senhor.
verses.en_web: In that day, I will punish all those who leap over the threshold, who fill their master’s house with violence and deceit.
verses.en_bbe: And in that day I will send punishment on all those who come jumping over the doorstep and make their master's house full of violent behaviour and deceit.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD, that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and an howling from the second, and a great crashing from the hills.
verses.pt: E naquele dia, diz o Senhor, far-se-á ouvur uma voz de clamor desde a porta dos peixes, e um uivo desde a segunda parte, e grande estrépito desde os outeiros.
verses.en_web: In that day, says Yahweh, there will be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.
verses.en_bbe: And in that day, says the Lord, there will be the sound of a cry from the fish doorway, and an outcry from the new town, and a great thundering from the hills, and cries of grief from the people of the Hollow;

verses.en: Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.
verses.pt: Uivai vós, moradores de Mactes, porque todo o povo de Canaã está arruinado; todos os que pesam a prata são destruídos.
verses.en_web: Wail, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the people of Canaan are undone! All those who were loaded with silver are cut off.
verses.en_bbe: Because of the downfall of all the people of Canaan: all those who were weighted down with silver have been cut off.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.
verses.pt: E há de ser que, naquele tempo, esquadrinharei a Jerusalém com lanternas, e castigarei os homens que se embrutecem com as fezes do vinho, que dizem no seu coração: O Senhor não faz o bem nem faz o mal.
verses.en_web: It will happen at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men who are settled on their dregs, who say in their heart, “Yahweh will not do good, neither will he do evil.”
verses.en_bbe: And it will come about at that time, that I will go searching through Jerusalem with lights; and I will send punishment on the men who have become like wine stored over-long, who say to themselves, The Lord will not do good and will not do evil.

verses.en: Therefore their goods shall become a booty, and their houses a desolation: they shall also build houses, but not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, but not drink the wine thereof.
verses.pt: Por isso as riquezas deles se tornarão em despojo e as suas casas em desolação; e edificarão casas, mas não habitarão nelas; e plantarão vinhas, mas não lhes beberão o vinho.
verses.en_web: Their wealth will become a plunder, and their houses a desolation. Yes, they will build houses, but won’t inhabit them. They will plant vineyards, but won’t drink their wine.
verses.en_bbe: And their wealth will be violently taken away, and their houses will be made waste: they will go on building houses and never living in them, and planting vine-gardens but not drinking the wine from them.

verses.en: The great day of the LORD is near, it is near, and hasteth greatly, even the voice of the day of the LORD: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.
verses.pt: O grande dia do Senhor está perto; sim, está perto, e se apressa muito; ei-la, amarga é a voz do dia do Senhor; clama ali o homem poderoso.
verses.en_web: The great day of Yahweh is near. It is near, and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of Yahweh. The mighty man cries there bitterly.
verses.en_bbe: The great day of the Lord is near, it is near and coming very quickly; the bitter day of the Lord is near, coming on more quickly than a man of war.

verses.en: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,
verses.pt: Aquele dia é dia de indignação, dia de tribulação e de angústia, dia de alvoroço e de assolação, dia de trevas e de escuridão, dia de nuvens e de densas trevas,
verses.en_web: That day is a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,
verses.en_bbe: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and sorrow, a day of wasting and destruction, a day of dark night and deep shade, a day of cloud and thick dark.

verses.en: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.
verses.pt: dia de trombeta e de alarido contra as cidades fortificadas e contra as torres altas.
verses.en_web: a day of the trumpet and alarm, against the fortified cities, and against the high battlements.
verses.en_bbe: A day of sounding the horn and the war-cry against the walled towns and the high towers.

verses.en: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the LORD: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.
verses.pt: E angustiarei os homens, e eles andarão como cegos, porque pecaram contra o Senhor; e o seu sangue se derramará como pó, e a sua carne como esterco.
verses.en_web: I will bring distress on men, that they will walk like blind men, because they have sinned against Yahweh, and their blood will be poured out like dust, and their flesh like dung.
verses.en_bbe: And I will send trouble on men so that they will go about like the blind, because they have done evil against the Lord: and their blood will be drained out like dust, and their strength like waste.

verses.en: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’S wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.
verses.pt: Nem a sua prata nem o seu ouro os poderá livrar no dia da indignação do Senhor; mas pelo fogo do seu zelo será devorada toda a terra; porque certamente fará de todos os moradores da terra uma destruição total e apressada.
verses.en_web: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh’s wrath, but the whole land will be devoured by the fire of his jealousy; for he will make an end, yes, a terrible end, of all those who dwell in the land.
verses.en_bbe: Even their silver and their gold will not be able to keep them safe in the day of the Lord's wrath; but all the land will be burned up in the fire of his bitter wrath: for he will put an end, even suddenly, to all who are living in the land.
